verdict.rationale: Superpowers batches small same-shape plan tasks into a single subagent dispatch. Batch reviews then check that every file in the brief made it into the diff, and `/execute-plan` runs batched implementation plans across many tasks, with agents working through each task autonomously. This is bulk execution inside the coding-plan workflow, not a general-purpose bulk-operations feature, and the only evidence is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: a general bulk-operation capability beyond plan-task batching, documentation of batch scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of batching.
